impl From<SelectorParams> for Selector {
    fn from(p: SelectorParams) -> Self {
        Selector {
            in_: p.in_.into_iter().map(Into::into).collect(),
            in_any: p.in_any.into_iter().map(Into::into).collect(),
            not_in: p.not_in.into_iter().map(Into::into).collect(),
            max_depth: p.max_depth,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct FindParams {
    #[schemars(description = "Fuzzy search query matching against document title and key")]

    #[schemars(description = "Only return root documents (no incoming block references)")]
    pub roots: Option<bool>,
    #[schemars(description = "Only return documents that reference this key")]

- **`Find` struct (line 134)** — clap-derived struct describing the `find` subcommand. The `--meta` flag is declared as:
  ```rust
  #[clap(long = "meta", value_parser = parse_meta_filter,
         help = "Filter by front matter field (key=value); repeatable")]
  meta: Vec<(String, String)>,
  ```
  Because the field type is `Vec<…>`, clap accepts the flag repeatedly, e.g. `--meta status=ready --meta tags=rust`, producing one entry per occurrence.

- **`parse_meta_filter(s: &str) -> Result<(String, String), String>` (line 654)** — the custom value parser. It splits each argument on the first `=`, trims whitespace from both halves, and returns `(key, value)`. Strings without `=` produce a clap error.

- **`main` dispatch (line 557)** — `Command::Find(find) => find_command(find)`.

### 2. Translating CLI args into a `FindOptions` — `find_command` (line 661, same file)

```rust
let finder = DocumentFinder::new(&graph);
let options = FindOptions {
    query:      args.query,
    roots:      args.roots,
    refs_to:    args.refs_to.map(|s| Key::name(&s)),
    refs_from:  args.refs_from.map(|s| Key::name(&s)),
    selector:   args.selector.into(),
    limit:      args.limit,
    metadata_filters: args.meta,   // <-- the parsed --meta pairs flow in here
};

```

(For the MCP/JSON-RPC path in `crates/iwec/src/lib.rs`, `FindParams.meta` is similarly mapped via `impl From<FindParams> for FindOptions` at line 121 — same destination field.)

- **`FindOptions` struct (line 36)** — carries `metadata_filters: Vec<(String, String)>` along with the other filters.

- **`DocumentFinder::new(&graph)` (line 51)** — wraps a borrow of the in-memory `Graph`.

- **`DocumentFinder::find(&FindOptions) -> FindOutput` (line 55)** — the orchestrator. It iterates every key in the graph and applies a chain of filters in order:

  1. `selector.resolve(self.graph)` candidate set (if any structural selector was supplied).

  3. `--refs-to` (`references`).
  4. `--refs-from` (`references`).

     if !options.metadata_filters.is_empty()
